item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] California couple's surrogate gives birth in Texas after judge orders life-saving care
item.description: A California couple’s surrogate who went to Texas in an escalating dispute over treating a congenital heart condition gave birth Wednesday.

item.description: GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic are booming. Experts share red flags and tips for finding a safe telehealth provider.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: Foreclosure Risks
